title: Ukrainian deep strikes were launched four years ago by HUR unit – military commander

Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha believes that the Ukrainian-Polish partnership could become one of the key drivers shaping Europe's new economic and security order.

title: Ukrainian forces have liberated more territory than Russia has captured in recent months, Khmara says

Ukrainian forces have liberated more territory than Russia has captured in recent months, Khmara says

Four years ago, on November 11, 2022, Ukraine’s Defense Forces liberated Kherson from Russian occupation. Ukrainian troops continue to conduct offensive operations and have liberated more territory in recent months than Russian forces have captured.
